# **We protect the workplaces the world relies on most**

## Envoy unifies people, spaces, and communications in one secure platform and ecosystem, so every workplace runs with clarity and confidence.

[![Envoy CEO Larry Gadea](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/64820bb890b5d776bb0c9faf/6a0f782b2e27f9fe9aed1c46_thumb_larry.webp)](https://envoy.com/about#)

More than 16,000 workplaces trust Envoy to run secure, compliant, and connected operations across every location. From manufacturing sites and data centers to life sciences labs, healthcare facilities, and cutting-edge technology, we help organizations protect the places where critical work happens every day.

Envoy brings visitor management, emergency management, digital signage, mailroom management, space planning, and resource booking into one integrated platform. Deep integrations across access control, identity, compliance, and collaboration tools help teams reduce risk, stay audit-ready, and operate with clarity at scale.

‍

Keep your workplaces secure, safe, and fully compliant with tailor-made policy customization that captures and completes records for all your compliance requirements, all while knowing who is in your workplace at all times.

We take the challenge out of making informed, data-driven workplace decisions. Gain valuable insights into workplace utilization through unified occupancy data and space usage analysis captured from multiple sources. Arm yourself with the knowledge to optimize staffing, resource allocation and real estate investments.

Whether you run a single site or a global portfolio, Envoy gives workplace, IT, security, and facilities leaders one trusted system to operate confidently, without added complexity.

## Our customers

Envoy works in thousands of workplaces, across industries, around the world. From global enterprises to growing teams, our customers count on us to keep their people, places, and operations protected.

[Explore our customer stories](https://envoy.com/case-studies)

## Join our team

Our customers count on us to keep their workplaces secure, compliant, and running. That responsibility shapes how we build.

We raise the bar, sweat the details, and own the outcome. We ship products we'd use ourselves. If that sounds like your kind of work, we’d love to meet you.

[See job openings](https://envoy.com/jobs)

![A blue wave with a white background.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/64820bb890b5d776bb0c9faf/6528a04c9bff87e769acc66c_custom-wave_white.png)

## Our values

Five core values guide everything we do. These principles keep us intentional, accountable, and unafraid to do the hard work.

![Envoy's core values. Create great experiences, choose action, stand out, communicate openly, pitch in.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/64820bb890b5d776bb0c9faf/69b1ede5ae65758a6b05dd69_core-values.webp)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/64820bb890b5d776bb0c9faf/69b0b8171944626038709d00_code_illo.svg)

Create great experiences

We bring care, curiosity, and craft to everything we do. We aim for great, not good.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/64820bb890b5d776bb0c9faf/69b0b86b55ed28b9d93cc4f5_bullhorn_illo.svg)

Communicate openly

We believe transparency builds trust, and trust makes great teams.

![Lightbulb](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/64820bb890b5d776bb0c9faf/69b0b86b68aafe8c1f60583c_lightbulb_illo.svg)

Stand out

We’re not afraid to do things differently or challenge what’s always been done.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/64820bb890b5d776bb0c9faf/69b0b86bf9a79945d088f1d4_tools_illo.svg)

Pitch in

We show up for each other and for the work. No ego, no hesitation.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/64820bb890b5d776bb0c9faf/69b0b86bd341234a7f2a8e11_list_illo.svg)

Choose action

We move forward with intention, confidence, and momentum.

![Two Envoy employees laughing in conversation in a bright red padded booth.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/64820bb890b5d776bb0c9faf/65289118ad6f9c6f629339df_office-2.jpg)
